I replied in #coastal-team: the official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands to Kwame was November 3, 2025.

That comes from Moss's Nov 2, 2025 Coastal digest ("tomorrow, 2025-11-03") and Bettina's cutover recap note. The recap also says Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22, 2025. I included both dates so he can pick the right one for the CRM.
